anomalies.obs: On the NAVC Peripherals sheet the BMI088 (U16) has no‑connect flags (×) on CSB2 (pin 5) and SDO2 (pin 15), while CSB1 (pin 14) and SDO1 (pin 10) are tied to +3.3 V and PS (pin 7) is tied to +3.3 V for I²C mode.
anomalies.expected: For I²C operation the gyro's CSB2 must be tied high (to VDDIO) to select I²C mode, and SDO2 must be tied high to give the gyro address 0x69 stated in the schematic note and in the design specification's component table ('Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)').

evidence.quote: NAVC Peripherals: U16 BMI088 — pin 5 CSB2 with no‑connect flag, pin 15 SDO2 with no‑connect flag; note 'I2C address: 0x19 (acc) 0x69 (gyr)'
IMU (accel + gyro) | NAVCPeripherals | Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)

anomalies.impact: With CSB2/SDO2 floating the gyro may not enter/hold I²C mode and its 7‑bit address is undefined (not 0x69), so the navigation computer cannot read gyroscope data, breaking the IMU/attitude estimation.

parsed.summary: The power, MCU, and most peripheral sections match the specification (including the documented barometer RESET/EOC mix‑up, which is not reported). The one supported deviation is on the BMI088: CSB2 and SDO2 are left as no‑connects, contradicting the stated 0x69 gyro address and standard I²C‑mode wiring, which would prevent reliable gyroscope communication.
